sources.name: background
sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a finished high-quality unique CLEAN BACKGROUND PLATE for portrait4:5 jigsaw puzzle illustration "A bakery doorway beside a tree-lined residential street". Premium cozy travel-game storybook digital painting matching approved Art Direction V2 gameplay art: tactile subtly brushed surfaces, fine hand-painted detail, believable dimensional objects, gentle upper-left sunlight, rich color separation and small discoveries. NOT flat vector, NOT photorealistic, NOT generic procedural art. A deep berry-red painted bakery entrance and facade dominate at least60% of the picture. Unlettered glass-fronted doorway, baskets of bread, residential cobblestone path and a few pots/tree branches. No signage or readable text, no famous buildings. Calm human-free scene. Viewpoint: gently elevated three-quarter view. The picture must fill the entire portrait4:5 canvas, ideal1280x1600; no borders, text, UI, grid, title, logo, watermark or transparent holes. This is a complete naturally composed environment with real stable anchors for five small moving details later added as separate alpha layers. Do not add floating decorative particles or overlay patterns. Preserve coherent scale and perspective. No famous destination landmark. Keep the requested main color visible throughout the scene, not only a tiny accent.

sources.name: atlas
sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A production RGBA transparent sprite atlas of five unique painted details belonging to the scene "A bakery doorway beside a tree-lined residential street". Match a premium cozy illustrated puzzle: rich dimensional storybook digital painting, subtle brushed pigment, believable natural forms, fine detail, soft upper-left sun, coherent warm light and tactile materials. No flat vector, no photos, no generic geometric particles. EXACTLY five isolated objects, strict3 columns by2 rows, landscape3:2 canvas. Leave the sixth bottom-right cell perfectly empty transparent. TRUE alpha transparency, no matte, no background, no grid or cell borders, no frame, no shadow rectangle, no labels or text. Place each entire object inside the central50% of its own cell, leaving wide25% gutters on every side. FULL complete loops, stems, wings, wisps and thin strands must fit safely inside each cell; none may touch canvas or cell edges. Top row left to right: a small ivory geranium blossom sprig with two leaves and tapered bottom stem; a short dark ivy twig with five sunlit leaves and narrow lower stem; a small burgundy cloth pennant tied to a narrow top cord, no text. Bottom row left to right: a small rough ivory linen tassel, fine woven fibers, tied at top; one little golden honeybee with delicate wings, angled left in flight; EMPTY. Preserve detailed painted alpha edges and translucent material where specified. Do not include containers, scenery or extra items. All five details are real meaningful parts of this specific scene, sharing its scale and light.
